name: Devin Apps
desc: Private web applications hosted on the machine Devin works in.
desc_zh: 托管在 Devin 工作机上的私有网页应用。
solves: Internal tools used to need a server and a domain; the agent builds the app and it stays on the same machine as the code.
solves_zh: 内部小工具过去要配服务器和域名；智能体建好应用，就和代码待在同一台机器上。
best_for: You want a dashboard over a service you just built, visible only to your team.
best_for_zh: 刚做好一个服务，想给它加个只有团队能看的看板。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — devin.ai/blog directory）。 The blog index shows the same post one day later, 2026-11-16, because it renders in Asia/Shanghai; the post page date is used here. 首次公开日期来源：https://devin.ai/blog/devin-apps
